description: Typed per-RPC negative-matrix access classes (F5, #1194). Every compiled RPC maps to one named class in `access_classes`; zero per-RPC prose rationales.

situations.b: Character A acting on character B's item, ship, order, contract, facility, reprocess dest, or bound object
situations.c: Corporation member with no roles acting on the corporation wallet, hangar, or structure
situations.d: Docked pilot calling a method that only makes sense in space
situations.e: Pilot in space 500 km away from the target, or in another solar system
situations.f: Warp-scrambled or cloaked pilot calling a movement or jump method

StrictProtected.description: Denied across all negative-matrix situations (a..f): requires authentication, ownership/role authorization, and valid scene state.

AuthRead.description: Authenticated read-only or catalog RPC without target ownership, corp-role, scene, or movement gates.

TargetAndCorpGated.description: Caller-owned/target-gated and corp-role-gated RPC valid in both docked and space scenes.

TargetOwnedAction.description: Authenticated target-ownership-gated RPC with no corporation-role, scene, or movement restriction.

SelfScopedMutation.description: Authenticated caller-scoped mutation allowed in Situation b while preserving strict Target B invariance.

DockedProtected.description: Docked-scene RPC enforcing authentication, target ownership, and corporation role authorization.

PublicRead.description: Pre-authentication read-only or catalog RPC allowed across all situations (a..f).

SpaceNonMovement.description: In-space RPC exempt from distance/system and warp-scramble/cloak checks while enforcing auth, ownership, corp role, and in-space scene.

CorpRoleRead.description: Read-only RPC requiring corporation roles in Situation c without target-B or scene/movement restrictions.

DockedRead.description: Docked-scene read-only or self-query RPC allowed in situations b, c, and d.

DockedSelfMutation.description: Docked-scene caller-scoped mutation allowed in Situation b with strict Target B invariance, c, and d.

MovementExempt.description: In-space maneuver RPC exempt from warp-scramble/cloak blocking (Situation f) while gated on a..e.

DockedTargetOwned.description: Docked-scene RPC gated on auth, target ownership, and space scenes, without corp-role gating in Situation c.

PreAuthRestricted.description: Pre-auth RPC callable before login (Situation a) that enforces session/caller authorization once authenticated.

DockedOrNonMoveTarget.description: Bind/facility RPC permitted while docked or non-movement-blocked without corp-role gating (c, d, f).

PublicSelfMutation.description: Pre-auth caller-scoped session mutation (e.g. authentication.Logout) allowed across a..f while preserving Target B invariance.

CorpZeroRoleOnly.description: Authenticated self-character lifecycle RPC without corp-role restriction (c) and gated across a, b, d, e, f.
